summary: SSHSettings — settings for SSH and SFTP connections backed by paramiko. No discriminator needed — SFTP is just the subsystem opened after connecting with the same SSHClient. Accepts PasswordAuth, CertificateAuth, or KeyAuth.
lifecycle_notes: Consolidated SSH + SFTP into one class (previously two) in Phase 4
documentation_hooks: Document that SFTP is activated by the backend subsystem, not a settings field

evidence.detail: Tests SSHSettings with various auth modes
